$comment: A complete fix-bugs installation, with placeholder values. This is what you hand the harness when you install the package; the agent-package.json configurationSchema is what validates it. Where the agent's QUESTIONS go is not in here: that is the Human Eyes plugin, installed on the harness once (board URL + token) and granted to this agent.

dataSources.description: Open rows from the product's report-a-bug table, newest first.
dataSources.query: SELECT id::text AS id, summary AS title, details, reporter, created_at FROM bug_reports WHERE status = 'open' ORDER BY created_at DESC
